verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਕੈ ਵਾਲ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਚਵਰ ਕਰਿ ਢਾਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: sir vich nikai vaal hoi saadhoo charan chavar kar ddaalai|

en.bdb: Preparing the whisk of even the hair of one's head (the gurmukh) one should  wave it on the feet of the saints i.e. he should be extremely humble.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ਕੈ ਅੰਝੂ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਪੈਰਿ ਪਖਾਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sar teerath nai kai a(n)jhoo bhar bhar pair pakhaalai|

en.bdb: Bathing  in the pilgrimage place, he should wash the feet of the Guru with tears of  love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਧਉਲੇ ਕਰੇ ਚਲਣ ਜਾਣਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaalee hoo(n) dhaule kare chalan jaan neesaan samhaalai|

en.bdb: From black, his hair may turn grey but then considering his time to  go (from this world) he should cherish in his heart the symbol (love) of the  Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paa khaak hoi pooraa satigur nadhar nihaalai|

en.bdb: When one, falling at the Guru's feet, becomes dust himself, i.e. totally deletes ego from his mind, the true Guru also then blesses and obliges  him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਗ ਕੁਮੰਤਹੁੰ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਉਜਲ ਮੋਤੀ ਖਾਇ ਖਵਾਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaag kuma(n)tahu(n) param ha(n)s ujal motee khai khavaalai|

en.bdb: He should become swan and leave black wisdom of crow and should  himself perform and get others perform pearl-like invaluable deeds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਾਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: vaalahu nikee aakheeaai gur sikhee sun gursikh paalai|

en.bdb: The  teachings of the Guru are subtler even than the hair itself; the Sikh should  always follow them.
The Sikhs of the Guru go across the world-ocean by  virtue of their cup full of love.
